|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “▲ any Cave. OR If opponent just deployed a planet site, ▼any related location.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Take a cave into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just deployed a planet site, deploy a related location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “▲ any Cave.” → “Take a cave into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “▼any” → “deploy a”; “location.” → “location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 26. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[A Dark Time For The Rebellion]]. Code OVS4 · GEMP id 1104_26.
